title: Chapter 125: Take Your Mannequins Away!
html:
Before attempting the Third Sick Hall’s Trial Mission, perhaps I should place a stray cat in the Mu Yang High School scenario and test the theory. If it works, I’ll have another defense against creatures from the other side.That information alone made the trip worthwhile. Chen Ge held the rusted key out to Xiao Du. “Have you seen this before?”

“Yes.” Xiao Du nodded. “At sunrise, I would clean the animal carcasses out of Room 303. One morning, I found this key in a piece of clothing.”

“Did the man in your dream ever mention a key, a special door, or a room?”

Xiao Du considered the question. “Once, while they were talking to each other, I think they mentioned something about one.”

“What was it?”

“One face said he had left something important in the third room. He also said the passage behind the cupboard was unlocked, and that they should have used it instead of the front door. Then they wouldn’t have been exposed.” The memory was hazy; Xiao Du had heard the conversation only in a dream.

“The third room?” Chen Ge was reminded of the paper note left behind by his parents.

The third room in the Third Sick Hall!

Could they mean the same place? If so, this information is invaluable. The passage behind the cupboard is unlocked; it could become my escape route.

Chen Ge could not tell whether Xiao Du was lying, so he kept his expression neutral and committed every detail to memory. After several more questions confirmed that Xiao Du knew nothing else, he returned to Room 304.

“How is Men Nan doing?”

“He’s asleep, but he has a fever. I’ll take him to the hospital in the morning and try contacting his family again.” Doctor Gao sat beside the bed. “You should rest. I’ll watch him. I put your doll on the sofa, and there are bandages under the table. Take care of your wounds.”

“Okay.” Doctor Gao was a genuinely considerate man. On the sofa, Xiaoxiao lay flat on her back with her stomach bulging, as if she had eaten too much to move.

“You little glutton.” Chen Ge set an alarm for 7:00 a.m. and fell asleep hugging her. His rest was fitful. In a recurring dream, something chased him through a maze-like building. Danger pressed close behind while he tried the key in his hand on door after door, but none would open.

…

“Wake up.”

Someone shook him awake. Doctor Gao stood beside the sofa, supporting a frail-looking Men Nan. Dawn light seeped through the window; it was about 6:00 a.m.

“His fever is still high. We need to take him to the hospital. Something about this room feels wrong, so I think we should all leave together.” Doctor Gao looked haggard after a sleepless night, and Men Nan seemed ready to collapse.

“All right.” Chen Ge packed his belongings and took Men Nan’s other arm. “Careful.”

“Thank you for last night…” As they left Room 304, Men Nan suddenly turned toward Chen Ge and repeated, “Thank you.”

“You’re welcome,” Chen Ge replied automatically. Then he realized that Men Nan’s voice and manner had sounded strangely feminine. When he looked again, the young man had lowered his head.

Once they reached the hospital and doctors confirmed that Men Nan was out of immediate danger, Chen Ge left. In the taxi, he checked the black phone and found the mission-completion message.

“The player reached the mission venue on time, discovered the cause of the victim’s illness, and survived until sunrise. One-Star Trial Mission completed! A new scenario has been unlocked. The player can freely manipulate the set’s props through the phone!

“Trial Mission completion rate exceeded ninety percent. Hidden item unlocked: Self-Perceptive Key.

“Self-Perceptive Key (13 Malice Points): Those suffering from mental illness often lack insight into their own condition. Believing themselves healthy, they may refuse treatment. If similar symptoms appear in you, this key can help you once.”

The key I found is the mission’s hidden item?Chen Ge examined it in his palm. What does it mean by “if similar symptoms appear in you”? Is the phone implying that I’m mentally ill?

Chen Ge reached New Century Park around 7:00 a.m. One-Star Missions really aren’t that difficult. I’m not nearly as exhausted as usual.

Since it was still early, he decided to visit the mannequin workshop. The heads he had made should be ready. He messaged the owner and received an immediate reply asking him to come at once.

Did something happen? Perhaps I made a mistake because I lacked the proper tools.

This was the first time Chen Ge had used that skill. He was afraid of an accident, so he rushed over immediately.

When he arrived, the owner stood alone outside the glass door, key in hand, seemingly afraid to enter.

“You’re already here? Then, why won’t you go in?” Chen Ge walked toward the man. If some outsiders saw this, they would probably think that he was the boss.

The owner’s jowls trembled as he pointed into the workshop. “Can I cancel your order?”

“No way, you’ve already accepted my down payment.” Chen Ge looked through the glass into the workshop. When his eyes swept across the counter where he had left yesterday’s half-finished products, his breath caught in his throat.

All twenty-four severed heads had turned toward the entrance, their expressions disturbingly human. Chen Ge nearly reached for his mallet. No wonder the owner refused to go in alone.

“They do look realistic.” Chen Ge patted the boss’ shoulder. “Open the door, will you? After finishing the bodies, I’ll leave.”

“You’re far too modest. Twenty-four heads, every one wearing a different expression, all staring at the door—and ‘realistic’ is all you can say? When I arrived this morning, they nearly scared the soul out of me!” The owner grimaced. “I came early to check the filler and make sure nothing had leaked, but… sigh. I’ll remember this every time I unlock the door. Now I’ll have to rent the place out no matter what.”
